about: PO-3 economy settings thin client: Pepe's pushes, his routing verdicts, his H1 export, a chat write-through and a rollback write-back (camfrog-bot tools/gen_policycfg_contract.py; PATV test/policycfg-contract.test.js replays it)

voice.label: Voices, per use (after the voice owner's royalty)

voice_unlock.label: Voice unlocks (!buyvoice, after the voice owner's royalty)

soundboard_room.label: Soundboard plays of a pad's own clips

heist_gear.label: Heist shop gear (the rest goes to the Federal Reserve)

cosmetics.label: Cosmetics (shop buys + the 5% market fee; no room -> Fort Knox)

blackjack_losses.label: Blackjack: losing bets (wins are paid from the jackpot)

lotto_tickets.label: Lotto tickets (40% lotto pot first; this row splits the other 60%)

bounty_fee.label: Bounty fee (5% of a paid bounty)

heist_market_fee.label: Heist market fee (5% of each player-to-player heist item sale)

raffle_fee.label: Raffle fee (10% of a community raffle's ticket sales)

wheel.label: Wheel spins (set on the website: 100% to the jackpot; the House keeps all of it - 1.99pk)

loan_interest.label: Loan interest (the protocol's 10% cut of player-loan interest; the lender keeps 90%)

turf_buyins.label: Claim / invasion buy-ins (when not refunded or won by defenders)

auto_escrow_expired.label: Unclaimed chat-account escrow (auto accounts' free rewards, 6 months after their last activity; website)

wheel_shortfall.label: Wheel prize the jackpot can't cover / reseed

room_owner.label: Pad owner royalties (website, weekly, if the pad was active)

turf_income.label: Turf income top-up, tip tap, skim, interest & bonuses

room_owner_hold.label: Where the pad owner's share is held until the weekly royalty

dests: 🎁 Incentive budget (payouts only; fills from the Treasury surplus)
📈 Staked stashes (scaled by the staking dial)
🏠 Pad owner (weekly; held per the 'Pad owner share (held)' row)
🏦 Pad vault of the pad it was spent in (no room or no vault: Fort Knox)
